body_markdown:
#### Compass Minerals Names Brett Teuscher Chief Accounting Officer


Compass Minerals today announced Brett Teuscher has been named chief accounting officer.


In this role, he will serve as the principal accounting office for the company. Teuscher will have lead responsibility for all technical accounting matters, accounting policy and standards, and the management of external reporting requirements to ensure the timely and accurate preparation of the company’s financial filings.


“As our company continues to evolve, Brett has the knowledge, judgment and leadership capabilities necessary to excel in this role,” said Peter Fjellman, chief financial officer. “Since joining Compass Minerals, Brett has proven to be a highly capable, trusted and hands-on leader who combines deep technical expertise with sound decision-making and a strong commitment to continuous improvement. His collaborative approach and ability to work effectively across teams have helped drive meaningful results. I’m confident Brett will continue to make significant contributions to our success in this important role.”


Teuscher joined Compass Minerals in May 2026 as senior director, internal audit. He has more than 19 years of experience in finance and accounting. Most recently, he held positions of increasing responsibility at BlueScope, ultimately serving as director of finance transformation, ERM and procurement. Prior to that, he held finance and internal audit roles at Coloramo Federal Credit Union, UnitedHealth Group, Whirlpool, JCPenney and the Utah State Tax Commission. He earned both a Bachelor of Science in Accounting and a Master of Business Administration from Utah State University.
